plan.summary: Record Pied à Terre's closing date (already status closed, closingDate missing)
steps: Set closingDate 2026-08-25 on pied-a-terre-off-broadway-2026 from two independent sources that agree

actions.description: TDF Show Finder (https://www.tdf.org/shows/23077/pied-a-terre): "Closing Date: Aug 25, 2026"; TheaterScene review header (https://www.theaterscene.net/plays/offbway-plays/pied-a-terre/victor-gluck/, posted 2026-07-12): "Pied À Terre (through August 25, 2026)". Older listings (Playbill Apr 29, BWW Jun 24, Broadway.com inventory to Jul 29) predate the extensions. TodayTix dropped it after 2026-09-14.
